card.fires_on: Mostly the middle piece "cher" in Escherichia (coli), and similar middle pieces of rarer biological names like Ralstonia, tyrant and Rauwolfia. It also fires weakly on a few linking words in lists.

modes.label: Other biological names
modes.description: Middle pieces of less common genus or plant names, or of the word tyrant.

modes.label: Linking words in lists
modes.description: A word like "or" or a dash joining items in a list of names or labels.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next piece of a name, such as "osphere" or "bia", completing a long word.
card.plain: It fires partway through the long name Escherichia coli and similar Latin-style names, helping the model finish the word.
